authority.scope: R40 through R47 and completed frozen H5; sealed power plus bounded seam report; explicit source closure and all failed attempts; no newer candidate service
authority.include_result_rule: only cases actually listed in those batch protocols/results, including software ERROR and empty/partial prefixes; raw bytes metadata only
authority.additional_source_rule: read actual provenance/import/loader and report references only to complete needed source closure; unchanged same-byte PH1-PH4 content stays Git refs, not recopied blindly
exclude_active_trees_and_newer: all future physical trials and moving-hop implementations

scope.root_admission: explicit cutoff patterns plus needed executed/provenance/import/loader closure; no mtime selection
scope.case_admission: actual protocol case_names plus batch result/unstarted verification; no result-prefix sweep
